items.title: The right adjoint of pushforward along a pseudo-coherent closed immersion is the exact-support sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Let X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let i : Z -> X be a pseudo-coherent closed immersion, and let a be the right adjoint of Ri_*; the lemma asserts that a(K) = RSheafHom(O_Z, K) functorially for K in D_QCoh^+(O_X) (statement lines 2466-2477). The proof first notes that RSheafHom(O_Z, -) is a right adjoint of Ri_* by Lemma labelled lemma-sheaf-with-exact-support-adjoint, and then uses Lemma labelled lemma-sheaf-with-exact-support-quasi-coherent together with Lemma labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image-bounded-below to check that both functors send D_QCoh^+(O_X) into D_QCoh^+(O_Z) (proof lines 2479-2491). Since two right adjoints to the same functor are canonically isomorphic, the asserted functorial isomorphism follows. Matching the quasi-coherence and boundedness properties of the two candidate adjoints so that uniqueness of adjoints applies is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
